identification: Club-licensed framed 'Hawthorn F.C. 2008 AFL Premiers' commemorative display, Limited Edition 177/400, about 124 x 105 cm in a gilt frame on a dark brown mount with gold lettering. Contents: a sleeveless replica Puma Hawthorn guernsey with AFL Grand Final 2008 and TASMANIA patches (not signed), a sepia team premiership print (Hawthorn 18.7.115 d Geelong 11.23.89), a replica gold premiership medal on blue ribbon, and about 26 individual player photos each paired with a small white signature card bearing a faint Hawks logo watermark, captioned with number and name (2 Jarryd Roughead, 3 Jordan Lewis, 4 Rick Ladson, 6 Mark Williams, 33 Cyril Rioli, 23 Lance Franklin, 15 Luke Hodge Norm Smith Medallist, 5 Sam Mitchell Premiership Captain, Alastair Clarkson Premiership Coach, 12 Brad Sewell, 14 Grant Birchall, Campbell Brown, Brent Guerra (?), Stuart Dew etc). The signatures look hand-signed in black ink: each is different in pressure and flow and sits over the watermark, which is how genuine signed-card frames are made; it is not a printed facsimile as far as 800 px photos can show. Certificate of authenticity named in the catalogue, not photographed.

viewing_check: Look on the back for the certificate of authenticity and the maker (club, AFL licensed, Official Memorabilia etc). Tilt the glass to check the signature cards show ink sheen and pressure, not print; count the cards (should be 22 players plus coach and extras). Check the glass for cracks and the mount for fading or mould. Plan transport: 124 x 105 cm glazed frame.
